title: Zoey, Thorn-Violet
text: Legendary Follower / Companion. Unique. Zoey joins the operative as a violet breach duelist. If the operative is Rumi and Mira is also following, the Violet Triad grants an additional +1 Grit, +1 Signal, and +1 Guile.
flavor: Rumi opens the wound. Mira holds the mirror. Zoey decides what survives.
resolutionSummary: Zoey stepped from the violet storm and completed the triad around the active operative.

effects.text: Zoey acquired: legendary companion. Rumi gains the Violet Triad bonus if Mira is also following.

imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi companion card showing a purple-haired violet war-mage duelist in black thorn armor, holding pink-violet breach lightning in one hand and a jagged magenta signal sword in the other, standing before burning gothic-industrial towers and battle standards. She feels like the third member of Rumi and Mira's elite riftblade team, calm, elegant, dangerous, dark brass, violet storm light, cinematic Ashen Reach card art, no text.
